explanations: EmailChannel appends the unsubscribe footer by assigning to msg.body, mutating the OutboundMessage that Notifier passes to every channel in turn. If email is not delivered (retryable or rejected) and Notifier falls back to SMS, the SMS text now carries the email footer, eating into the length limit. Callers that reuse the message object (for example a retry of notify) get the footer appended again each time. The channel should build a local string; the interface could also take Readonly<OutboundMessage> to make this a compile error.

Notifier wraps channel.send in try/catch, converts any thrown error into a retryable outcome, records it, and continues the loop to the next channel. It does not rethrow, retry the same channel, or stop.

Email is skipped before any attempt because the address is null, and SmsChannel.supports returns false for low priority, so it is skipped too. No attempts are recorded and channel stays null; nothing throws.

SmsChannel maps any non-queued status to retryable. Notifier continues on both retryable and rejected (it only stops on delivered), so the 'stops' part of the rejected option is wrong as well; nothing is thrown, and failed is not treated as delivered.
